execute.implementation-summary: Implemented voiceprint extraction and speaker separation: src/embeddings.py — module-level librosa import plus _cleanup_broken_speechbrain_imports() to purge DeprecatedModuleRedirect/LazyModule entries from sys.modules after failed speechbrain imports (k2_fsa missing) which otherwise corrupt inspect.getmodule and break librosa lazy_loader; src/diarization.py — added split_by_voiceprint() sliding-window speaker segmentation with user/other/unknown labeling, needs_review marking, and _merge_same_speaker_windows() duration-weighted merge; _extract_segment_embedding() now accepts optional audio_array=(y, sr) to skip file IO. Added tests/test_voiceprint_extraction.py (4 tests), tests/test_voiceprint_split.py (5 tests), scripts/test_voiceprint.py one-click integration script (voiceprint-file selection preferring 声纹-named longest file, segments.json loading, audio-duration range guard, CLI audio path arg).
execute.test-evidence: pytest tests/test_voiceprint_extraction.py tests/test_voiceprint_split.py: 9 passed; full suite: 63 passed, 20 warnings

review.review-summary: Self-review: split_by_voiceprint validates voiceprint presence and zero-reference norm (safe degrade to unknown/needs_review), reuses parallel_workers for embedding extraction, and merges consecutive same-label windows with duration-weighted confidence. The speechbrain cleanup only removes DeprecatedModuleRedirect/LazyModule proxy entries after import failure, so subsequent librosa MFCC fallback works. Integration script guards against segment timestamps exceeding audio duration (observed with 180s trimmed audio vs 5670s segments.json) and auto-clips with a warning. No blockers identified.

verify.verification-result: Full suite: 63 passed, 20 warnings (includes 9 new voiceprint tests; existing 6 diarization tests pass, no regressions). Integration: voiceprint extracted from input/voiceprint/声纹.wav (192-dim, norm 1.0); 93 preprocessed segments from segments.json; full-length audio 20260731-112120.wav (4638.7s) auto-clipped to 66/93 segments in range; split produced 114 windows: user=56, other=56, unknown=2, needs_review=2 — speaker separation functioning.

archive.archive-summary: Archived Classic change voiceprint-speaker-separation. Voiceprint extraction now works reliably via the librosa MFCC fallback: module-level librosa import plus sys.modules cleanup of speechbrain's broken DeprecatedModuleRedirect proxies (k2_fsa missing) which previously corrupted inspect.getmodule and caused zero-vector embeddings. Speaker separation added as DiarizationModule.split_by_voiceprint(): 3s windows / 1.5s hop over preprocessed segments, cosine similarity vs enrolled voiceprint, user/other/unknown labels, needs_review for sub-threshold confidence, duration-weighted merge of consecutive same-label windows. Integration run on 20260731-112120.wav: 66/93 in-range segments → 114 windows: user=56, other=56, unknown=2, needs_review=2. Full test suite 63 passed.
